item.title: Atami Sea Fireworks: Year-Round Displays in a Natural Amphitheatre — Guide
item.description: The Atami Sea Fireworks Festival is unusual among Japan’s fireworks events in being held not once but on many dates throughout the year, including winter, when the crisp air makes the bursts especially sharp. The display explodes directly over Atami Bay, whose mountain-wrapped shape acts as a natural amphitheatre that amplifies each boom, and every show ends with the famous ‘silver waterfall’ finale, a curtain of light poured low across the water; ryokan rooms and the beachfront both make fine vantage points.
